title: Polynomial growth of Sobolev norms of solutions of the fractional NLS equation on $\mathbb{T}^d$
summary: We study polynomial growth of Sobolev norms for the defocusing fractional nonlinear Schrödinger equation on the standard torus $\mathbb{T}^d$, $d \ge 2$. Uniform stationary phase and a frequency-dependent subdivision of time give Strichartz estimates which yield local well-posedness and, for the cubic equation, unconditional polynomial growth when $α> d^2/(d+2)$. The local theory and growth estimates extend to every integer-power nonlinearity $|u|^{2σ}u$, with explicit thresholds and growth exponents.
